avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Potent CYP3A4 inducer reduces crizotinib plasma concentrations and efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid completely; do not use concurrently with crizotinib therapy

avoid_supplements.name: Echinacea
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inducer may decrease crizotinib bioavailability
avoid_supplements.action: Discontinue use prior to and during crizotinib treatment

avoid_supplements.name: Grapefruit seed extract
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibitor increases crizotinib levels; risk of toxicity
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid supplemental extracts; advise patient to avoid grapefruit products

caution_supplements.name: Goldenseal
caution_supplements.mechanism: Potential CYP3A4 induction may modestly affect crizotinib metabolism
caution_supplements.action: Monitor efficacy; use with caution and inform clinical team

caution_supplements.name: Milk thistle
caution_supplements.mechanism: May weakly induce CYP3A4; limited clinical evidence but possible interaction
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for changes in tolerability or efficacy if used concurrently

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit and grapefruit juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition increases crizotinib plasma concentration and adverse effects
avoid_foods.action: Completely avoid grapefruit and fresh grapefruit juice during treatment

avoid_foods.name: Seville oranges (bitter oranges)
avoid_foods.mechanism: Contains furanocoumarins; inhibits CYP3A4 similarly to grapefruit
avoid_foods.action: Avoid fresh Seville oranges and marmalades made from Seville oranges

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May increase crizotinib absorption; modest effect on bioavailability
caution_foods.action: Take with consistent food intake; counsel patient on adherence with/without food as directed

caution_foods.name: Pomegranate juice
caution_foods.mechanism: Weak CYP3A4 inhibition; may marginally increase crizotinib levels
caution_foods.action: Monitor tolerability if consumed regularly; limit intake or discuss with healthcare provider

monitoring_notes: Crizotinib is a substrate of CYP3A4 and sensitive to enzyme induction/inhibition; monitor for loss of efficacy with inducers and increased adverse effects (QT prolongation, hepatotoxicity) with inhibitors. Counsel patients on strict avoidance of grapefruit products and strong CYP3A4 inducers, and maintain consistent dietary patterns during therapy.
